decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By combining artifact creatures like Thought Monitor and Emry, Lurker of the Loch with powerful artifact cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain pressure throughout the game. Additionally, disruptive cards such as Pithing Needle and Metallic Rebuke help control the opponent's strategy while cards like Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide additional card advantage and utility. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, resilient, and versatile in combat situations.

The main theme of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. It focuses on quickly building a board presence and dealing damage efficiently. The deck includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, as well as spells like Galvanic Discharge and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the board and deal damage. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to provide additional versatility and options for winning the game. The deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and efficient removal spells to overwhelm opponents quickly. The key strategy involves utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage early on, while also using cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge for additional reach and removal. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah also provides a powerful late-game threat. The deck also includes some control elements with Static Prison and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain board control. The mana base is designed to facilitate consistent casting of spells in a fast-paced format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick, efficient creature aggression backed up by powerful spells and enchantments to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The main strategy is to play aggressively with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also using cards like Guide of Souls and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to maintain board presence. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and evasion for your creatures. Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment offer direct damage options, while Expressive Iteration helps to dig for key cards. Static Prison and Arena of Glory provide control elements and additional support for your creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to efficiently deal damage early on using creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while also utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off opponents. The deck also includes cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for added aggression, and uses Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for both removal and a potential game-winning ultimate ability. The deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value and flexibility, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ocelot Pride adds resilience and card advantage to the strategy. Additionally, cards like Voice of Victory and Witch Enchanter offer a way to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure on the board.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and Talisman of Creativity to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It includes control elements like Torpor Orb, Kozilek's Return, and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck also utilizes Through the Breach to cheat out big threats early in the game. Palantír of Orthanc helps draw cards and Nulldrifter provides card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith and Faithless Looting in order to bring out powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One for free. By using cards like Burning Inquiry and Goblin Lore, you can also disrupt your opponent's hand while filling your own graveyard even faster. The aggressive nature of this deck allows you to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of powerful creatures, taking advantage of their early game plays.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Through the Breach. The deck also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate additional value by copying these creatures. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with massive threats from the graveyard, using cards like Devourer of Destiny and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine to support the reanimation strategy. Additionally, the deck includes control elements like Lightning Bolt and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on combining fast, efficient creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Dragon's Rage Channeler with powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to pressure opponents early and control the board. Cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig for needed cards, while Lava Dart provides additional reach. The addition of Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury offers a powerful finisher option, and the mana base allows for consistent casting of spells despite being three colors.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on early aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly pressure the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal and direct damage. Urza's Saga can generate value by tutoring for artifacts like Mishra's Bauble or Shadowspear. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and help recur lands, while Nethergoyf adds another threat to the board. The deck also includes lands like Blood Crypt and Stomping Ground for mana fixing and Boseiju, Who Endures for extra spell protection.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and control the board. Urza's Saga is included to provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while maximizing consistency. Overall, this deck aims to deploy threats quickly, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game with a variety of high-impact threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing creatures with powerful abilities and spells that can deal damage quickly. It also includes cards that can generate additional value by sacrificing creatures or creating tokens. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for casting spells of various colors. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature beats and direct damage, while also maintaining card advantage through token generation and card draw.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing cheap spells and creatures to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently use cantrips like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to find threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear the way. Mishra's Bauble provides card selection and helps trigger Prowess abilities on creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of counter spells and removal, while also utilizing card advantage and card selection to maintain control of the game. It leverages powerful instant speed removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, along with efficient counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Snare. The deck also includes win conditions in the form of creatures like Marang River Regent and Thundertrap Trainer, supported by card draw and selection tools like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Preordain. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility.

This deck aims to control the game by ramping up mana with UrzaTron lands and using powerful Eldrazi creatures to dominate the battlefield. It focuses on consistency and speed, utilizing cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to search for necessary pieces. Glaring Fleshraker and World Breaker provide disruption for the opponent, while Kozilek, the Broken Reality and Sire of Seven Deaths offer powerful finishers. The deck's strength lies in its ability to quickly assemble its Tron lands and overwhelm the opponent with its Eldrazi threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up its own resources. The inclusion of cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Brainsurge help to dig for key pieces of interaction. The deck also utilizes powerful board wipes like Terminus to deal with threats efficiently. With a mix of permission spells and card draw/filtering, it aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win.
